claims.claim: The commit-msg hook rejects a commit without a Signed-off-by trailer matching the author email
Hook requires 80% per-file coverage on changed non-test files
check-weak-assertions rejects tests asserting only NoError/Nil/NotNil
CLA Assistant bot requires signing the CLA on first PR
make coverage, make lint, make docs-reference, make docs-sdk-reference, make docs-voice exist
Integration tests use the integration build tag
make lint runs go vet, go fmt, golangci-lint, gosec and the message-pattern check
The SDK entry points are Open, OpenDuplex and OpenWorkflow
The Deprecation Gate fails a pull request that adds a Go Deprecated: marker unless it carries the deprecation-approved label; scripts/check-new-deprecations.sh runs the same check
install-hooks.sh installs the pre-commit and commit-msg hooks

make verify runs lint-diff (golangci-lint then gosec on changed modules) and test-fast (go test on changed modules); it skips the hook build, coverage, weak-assertion and drift steps and is not what CI runs
Go version is the one go.work declares
golangci-lint version is pinned in ci.yml and check-lint-version.sh refuses others
No root go.mod; go.work lists modules; make targets iterate modules
Twelve sdk/examples directories have their own go.mod (listed); others such as hello belong to the sdk module; make build does not build them
CI runs test, lint, build, weak-assertions jobs
